Supreme Court rules Yes Bank AT-1 bond write-off illegal

Yes Bank's share price fell 10% after the Supreme Court ruled the bank's write-off of ₹8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds illegal. The court's decision led to sharp selling of the bank's shares.
